description: Find what a change could break somewhere else before it ships, beyond the diff, and prove the one fact it is safe because of by running real code instead of writing it up. Trigger on "blast radius of X", "what could this break", "what else does this touch", or when reviewing a small diff you do not trust. For a static map of what imports what, use the `map-dependencies` skill.
